race.comment: BEYOND PERFECTION (1) has had only one outing and came a long last. However, it was well in the betting at his previous yard. Had a very reasonable excuse having cardiac arrhythmia so easy to give another go after a spell. SIMPLY SONNET (12) has been a bit up and down but sat a bit further forward last time. If she can find a spot quickly, she could be a contender here. ONA BIVVY (7) was beaten by some margin at both outings. This time he does get the inside draw so won't have to do a mountain of work early. PALE BLUE (2) is not blessed with a nice barrier but on breeding should have speed.
